summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the new ADAPTIVE onboarding assessments. Registered fresh grade-6 students (adt_144924@studybridge.org, adt_273351@studybridge.org / pass1234) and completed all three assessments one question at a time through the UI. English served exactly 20 questions, Overall 25, Career 20; each showed a single assess-question with counter, adaptive tests showed difficulty-indicator, last question button correctly switched to assess-submit. Results screens rendered (English: Level Advanced + 5 book suggestions; Overall: 1000/1000, mapped grade 12; Career: top 3 interests, no difficulty indicator as expected). result-continue returned to overview, cards showed completed check + 'Retake'. onboarding-continue was disabled initially and became enabled after all 3, navigating to /dashboard (dashboard shows Onboarding: Complete). Adaptive behavior verified in BOTH directions: all-correct trail 3->4->5 (capped at 5); all-wrong trail 3->2->1 (floored at 1), with filled difficulty bars matching the level.

issues: 'Difficulty X/5' label is text-[10px] at 50% accent opacity and the 'X / 20' counter at 50% opacity - both are hard to read on the dark background (low contrast); consider bumping size/opacity
Answer option text uses orange-50/70 on dark maroon - readable but borderline for WCAG AA

action_items: Optional: improve contrast/size of difficulty label and question counter text in Onboarding.jsx
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.jsx has no visible loading/skeleton state while POST /assessments/answer is in flight other than the '…' button label - acceptable, but rapid double clicks are guarded by the busy flag (verified no duplicate submissions).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 grade-6 student accounts: adt_649457@studybridge.org (abandoned), adt_144924@studybridge.org (all 3 assessments complete, onboarded), adt_273351@studybridge.org (partial English, wrong answers) - all password pass1234
context_for_next_testing_agent: Adaptive onboarding flow fully passes. Answer key for correct-answer automation can be regenerated from /app/backend/assessment_data.py (ENGLISH_BANK/OVERALL_BANK 'a' field) into a question-text -> answer-index JSON map; useful to drive difficulty upward. Career questions have no difficulty indicator (correct). Not retested in this run: dashboard/Learn/AI helper features.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional defects found. One earlier test failure was a test-side timing issue (asserted card presence immediately after redirect before render); fixed with wait_for_selector.
